fields.materials: Application Materials " * " means necessary documents that you must provide in your application. If you want to book our translation service , please pay and book it at least 2 weeks before the application deadline for submission of all documents; If you want to book our guardian service , you need to pay and book it 2 months before the application deadline, just in case your application fails because of failed to submit application documents on time. * 1. Non-criminal record report Applicants shall submit a valid certificate of Non-Criminal Record issued by the local public security authority, usually issued within 6 months prior to the submission date of the application. * 2. Financial statement or bank statement The available balance should be no less than 30,000 RMB (The minimum amount of financial proof for full scholarship applicants may be appropriately lowered). * 3. A Personal Statement No less than 800 words, stating your basic personal information, hobbies and expertise, motivation, study plan, etc. * 4. Foreigner Physical Examination Form The form shall be filled by the physician in Chinese or English. The physical examinations must cover all the items listed in the form with a suggestion filled by the doctor. Incomplete records or those without the signature of the attending physician, the official stamp of the hospital or a sealed photograph of the applicants are invalid. Attachments of examination results (Laboratory exam report, Electrocardiograph and Chest X-ray report) shall also be uploaded. Please carefully plan your physical examination schedule as the result is valid for only 6 months. Applicants in China can take the physical examination at the international travel health care center. You can download a template or sample from here . 5. Other Attachments For Arts programs, applicants must have related academic background and are required to submit the portfolio (such as paintings, story scripts, short movies, etc.). 6. Study or Work certificate For applicants who are currently studying or working in an institution, a Certificate of Enrollment or Employment issued by the institution is required. * 7. Certificate of HSK * 8. Information Page of Ordinary Passport. The passport must remain valid until after September 2025. For applicants who are already in China, a photocopy of Visa or Residence Permit with entry customs stamps should be provided as well. * 9. Passport photo A recent passport-sized photo of the applicant * 10. High school official transcripts Academic transcript in languages other than Chinese or English should be translated into Chinese or English and be certified by notarization. * 11. Notarized high school diploma Applicants who have already graduated from high school shall submit graduation certificate of high school. Prospective diploma recipients shall submit a pre-graduation certificate issued by the high school, and bring the official degree diploma for registration if admitted, otherwise the admission qualification will be cancelled. If the original copy is in a different language, a notarized translated version in Chinese or English must be submitted together * 12. CSCA Test Transcript(s) -You need to take the official CSCA test organized by the Chinese government and submit the corresponding subject result transcript(s) when applying. Learn more about the CSCA test >> -The test covers Chinese (Humanities and STEM Chinese), Mathematics, Physics, and Chemistry. Mathematics is required for all programs, while other subjects depend on the university’s specific requirements. -We are updating detailed information for each university, including the required subjects you have to take for each program and their score requirements. Once the updates are ready, you can check the attachment and information here for this university for the latest information. If no attachment is available yet, it usually means the university has not announced further details. You can download a template or sample from here . Tips: For applicants who are in China: If you are an employee, you still need to provide employment separation certificate and your current residence permit. If you are a student, you need to provide transfer certificate, leaving certificate, certificate of attendance rate issued by previous school and your current residence permit.
fields.requirements: Entry Requirements 1. Non-Chinese citizen with valid ordinary passport. Note: Applicants who emigrated to other countries from the Mainland China, Hong Kong, Macao or Taiwan and obtain foreign nationality, and applicants who has acquired foreign nationality automatically at the time of birth in a foreign country, whose parent(s) is (are) Chinese citizen(s), should meet the requirements of the regulations set in the Document No. 12 (2020) of Ministry of Education of the PRC (Click to check). 2. In good physical and mental health; in excellent academic standing and with good conduct; abide by the laws and decrees of China and comply with rules and regulations of Chongqing University. 3. Self-supported applicants should be above 18 years old and under 30 years old. 4. High school graduated or above, meeting the academic requirements of the applied program. 5. Chinese language proficiency: HSK 4 (≥210) or equivalent.
